result: EVERY one of the 126^2=15876 simultaneous 4x4 coordinate cuts of the 9x9 PPT state Q tensor Q, where Q is the 3x3 crosshatch state below, has an explicit nonnegative Schmidt-rank<=2 decomposition and is PPT. This exact finite result strengthens the earlier SR2-spanned-range-only result. It is NOT a statement about non-coordinate maps, arbitrary 4x4 PPT states, or the existence of a target SN>=3 witness.
source: Figure 1 of https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1: Q=[|10>+|02>]+[|20>+|12>]+[|00>+|21>]+[|01>+|22>], trace8. Its partial transpose is the sum of the four projectors [|12>+|00>]+[|22>+|10>]+[|01>+|20>]+[|02>+|21>], independently checked entrywise. Reordering Q tensor Q gives a 9x9 PPT state with trace64 and sixteen equal-weight 4-term tensor-edge kets. The four crosshatch edge supports are disjoint, so the sixteen tensor-edge supports remain disjoint under all coordinate cuts.
census: All 15876 outputs are nonzero. The projected source generators are partial permutation matrices, so their ranks equal their support sizes. There are 13688 cuts with no rank3-or4 generator, 2120 with one, and 68 with two, giving 2256 individual high-rank anchor obligations. In each of the 2256 certificates, a high-rank anchor is combined with at most three projected rank<=2 generators using signs +/-1 and distinct nonzero seventh-root phase exponents; all resulting q_z have rank<=2 for every z^7=1. For each of the 68 two-anchor cuts, the low-rank generators allocated to the two phase families are disjoint. An initial choice had 34 shared-budget conflicts; alternate exact certificates resolved all 34.
decomposition_proof: For an anchor q_h and its certificate terms (epsilon_j,q_j,e_j), define q_z=q_h+sum_j epsilon_j*z^(e_j)q_j, z^7=1. Exact cyclic polynomial minor checks prove SR(q_z)<=2. The exponents 0,e_j are pairwise distinct modulo7, so (1/7)sum_z[q_z]=[q_h]+sum_j[q_j]. Use this nonnegative phase average for each high-rank anchor and retain each unused source projector individually; those unused kets already have SR<=2. Disjoint allocated low-rank terms guarantee that no source projector is consumed twice. Hence the whole unnormalized cut is an SR2 positive sum. Local coordinate projection preserves the source PPT property; all cuts are nonzero and normalize to 4x4 PPT/SN<=2 states.
weighted_corollary: For any fixed coordinate cut and nonnegative source weights, the same recorded phase families remain a valid SR2 decomposition whenever each allocated low-rank generator has weight at least its anchor weight; the low allocations are disjoint, so remaining weights are nonnegative. PPT of such a differently weighted source is a separate requirement. The unconditional claim above is for the original equal-weight tensor Q tensor Q.

artifacts.observed: The independently written exact integer verifier rebuilds all 15876 cuts, checks the source partial transpose on all81 entries, validates partial-permutation ranks, every certificate key and sign, distinct phase residues, no shared low-term budget, and all 36096 3x3 minor polynomials modulo z^7-1 (252672 cyclic integer coefficients). It confirms 2256 anchors, exact coverage, no extra certificates and nonzero output in every cut. It imports no search code and uses no floats. The elementary seven-root average is the written bridge to a positive decomposition.

limits: Only the specific equal-weight 9x9 crosshatch tensor and simultaneous 4x4 coordinate cuts, plus the stated cut-specific weighted corollary. Arbitrary non-coordinate maps, other sources, a 4x4 SN>=3 witness, unrestricted 4x4 PPT states, independent human/cross-vendor review and novelty remain open.
